blocks.title: NP-hard
blocks.text: NP-hard problems are at least as difficult as the hardest problems in NP. No efficient algorithm is known for them, and they usually take a lot of time even for cases that are not very large.
The Travelling Salesman Problem is NP-hard: no known algorithm solves it quickly for many cities, because the number of routes grows factorially.
